turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Hi Elena, this is Sarah from Hypersale. You requested a demo yesterday. Did I catch you with a minute to discuss reducing manager coaching time?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Hi Sarah, this is Elena! Thanks for calling back so fast. Yeah, I’ve got a few minutes now. Reducing manager coaching time is definitely something I’m interested in—tell me more.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Absolutely, before I dive in, how are your SDRs practicing calls today, and how much manager time does that take each week?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Sure, so right now, my SDRs practice by recording mock calls and I review a handful myself. It takes a good chunk of time—probably around 8 to 10 hours a week just listening and giving feedback. And honestly, I can’t catch everything, so there’s definitely room for improvement. That make sense?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: That makes sense, how many SDRs are you supporting, and where do you see the biggest gaps when managers can't review every practice call?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: I’m supporting about 4 to 6 new SDRs each quarter. The biggest gaps show up in their cold call nerves and objection handling. When I can’t review every call, I miss those subtle patterns—like who’s improving and who’s stuck. Oh, interesting, right?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Definitely, how are those gaps affecting ramp time or conversion today, Hypersale lets SDRs practice realistic buyers, while managers track improvement from quote-backs' scores.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Right now, those gaps are adding a few extra weeks to ramp time. Some SDRs take longer to find their footing on live calls, and it’s tough to quantify who’s really ready. So having a way to track improvement with solid data—oh, that’s really appealing. How long does setup take on your side?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Setup for a pilot is typically light, we tailor scenarios and scoring with your team, would a 30 minute demo be a good next step?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Yes, that sounds great. Can we set up a 30-minute demo later this week? Maybe Thursday afternoon? And one more thing—can I see how my reps are improving over time during that demo?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Absolutely will show week-by-week improvement and the exact quotes behind every score. Would Thursday at 2 p.m. work for the demo?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Yes, Thursday at 2 p.m. works perfectly. I’m really looking forward to seeing that improvement data. Great, talk soon!
